notes.title: 提携発表 | Partnership Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Partnership Announcement[/p][p]We are pleased to announce that [i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i] will be published under [b]Happinet Indie Collection[/b], a label that selects and releases indie games from around the world.[/p][p]In addition, it has been decided that we will be co-exhibiting at [b]TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025[/b], starting on Thursday, September 25.[/p][p]Our development team is working hard to prepare so that even more people can discover the game.
 We would be truly grateful for your support.[/p][p]■About Happinet Indie Collection[/p][p]This label exists to showcase outstanding global indie titles to our consumers. We will not limit ourselves to specific genres; what matters to us is quality. And our audience can look forward to none but the best of the best in indie gaming.[/p][p]
OFFICIAL SITE：[/p][p][url="https://happinet-games.com/"]https://happinet-games.com/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 最新トレーラー 豪華声優発表 | New Trailer Featuring a Renowned Voice Actor
notes.content:
[p]Announcement[/p][p]
[/p][p]New Trailer Featuring a Renowned Voice Actor[/p][p]
[/p][p]We are excited to share that Kana Hanazawa, who provides the character voice in Mononoke no Kuni, narrates our brand-new trailer, released today![/p][p]
[/p][p]The trailer is now available on our official website and YouTube. It highlights both the story and gameplay, so please take a look.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Details about the character voiced by Kana Hanazawa will be revealed in future updates—please look forward to it![/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p]▼日本語[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3J-TwTeuzMw"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]▼英語[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tv0WtuxeEQM"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Kana Hanazawa – Selected Works[/p][p]・Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba (Mitsuri Kanroji)[/p][p]・Jujutsu Kaisen 0: The Movie (Rika Orimoto)[/p][p]・The Quintessential Quintuplets (Ichika Nakano)[/p][p]
[/p][p]We hope you’ll enjoy the trailer, and please look forward to what’s coming next![/p]

notes.title: Mononoke no Kuni: In Sincere Development!
notes.content:
[p]
Thank you as always for supporting [i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i].
 Our team is working day and night with sincerity, together with all of you, to make this world even more immersive and enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p]In the latest update, alongside the gentle and heartwarming atmosphere so far, terrifying yokai will appear, and players will be able to experience full-fledged battles.
 While preserving the warm world you’ve come to know, the game now adds thrilling exploration and tense encounters, evolving [i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i] into a deeper adventure about purifying the lingering regrets of spirits.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to continue growing [i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i] together with you by listening to your voices.
 What kinds of yokai encounters and battles would you like to experience? Please let us know in the comments.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we have released a brand-new trailer featuring Kana Hanazawa—who also appeared in [i]Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba[/i]—as the character voice for [i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i].
 We hope you’ll check it out![/p][p][/p][p]▼English[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tv0WtuxeEQM"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tv0WtuxeEQM"]

[/url]▼Japanese[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3J-TwTeuzMw"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We will be sharing development and update information on a regular basis!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]On Steam, we’ll be posting updates about the progress of [i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i], including:[/p][list][*][p]New feature additions[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Comments from the development team[/p][/*][/list][p]…and more! We also plan to share some behind-the-scenes insights about development here.[/p][p]We truly want to nurture [i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i] together with the community, so if you have any thoughts or impressions, please don’t hesitate to let us know in the comments![/p][p]—
[i]Mononoke no Kuni[/i] Development Team[/p][p]For more detailed updates or if you’d like to chat directly with us, come join our Discord server![/p][p]👉 [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/gJSHnAka"]https://discord.gg/gJSHnAka[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update from the dev team of "Mononoke No Kuni"
notes.content: [p]To all of our fans and supporters,  [/p][p][/p][p]We'd like to thank you again for following the progress of our game so far. We understand that there haven't been a lot of progress updates lately, but that's only because we're working around the clock to make sure that "Mononoke No Kuni" will be the best game that it can possibly be.  [/p][p][/p][p]That said, we hope to address this moving forward, regularly putting out more information and sharing the labor of love that is this game with all of the people that have become our fans and supporters, as well as those that are just interested in seeing where it goes, even as we ramp up development to even greater heights.  [/p][p][/p][p]We have a lot of big announcements and events coming up in the coming weeks/months, which should make it even easier for us to share more about "Mononoke No Kuni" with all of you. As always, we give our sincere thanks for your support. It is greatly appreciated!  [/p][p] -  [/p][p]The "Mononoke No Kuni" dev team.  [/p][p][/p][p]P.S. For anyone that wants to know more or communicate with us directly, feel free to come join our Discord server and say hi!  [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/gJSHnAka"]https://discord.gg/gJSHnAka[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677620/991d18e14590eac973611071c25dcf9e80e64a8d.png"][/img][/p]
